integrity: Exact symbolic derivative and area checks reproduced; continuum classification follows an analytic root argument. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns real aligned third and fifth Fourier cosine modes with a sufficient strict convexity bound; cusp counts are parameter occurrences. It does not classify other phases, higher modes, spatial intersections or all constant-width ovals. Earlier unindexed exact specializations remain possible.
title: A sharp three-wall caustic phase diagram for the first two constant-width harmonics
